fields.before: A robust beaked whale with a short beak, concave forehead profile and posterior dorsal fin. The selected mature male has pale head markings and paired apical lower teeth; erupted teeth and scarring vary with sex and age.
fields.after: A robust beaked whale with a short beak, a concave forehead profile and posterior dorsal fin. This artist exterior has a pale scarred head/body; sex, individual identity and age are not independently determined. Adult males can have erupted paired apical lower teeth, which are not resolved as separate tooth structures here.
